chatwoot-mailcow-crm.ctaHeading: WANT THIS DEPLOYED FOR YOUR TEAM?

sections.heading: 01 / WHAT IT IS
sections.content: Connecting (a self-hosted open-source email server) with (an open-source customer support & CRM inbox) turns every incoming customer email into a trackable conversation—giving early-stage teams a complete CRM workflow without expensive per-seat SaaS fees.

steps.title: HOST & ON YOUR OWN INFRASTRUCTURE
steps.detail: Deploy both containers on your VPS with clean DNS records (MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC) so your emails land in inboxes, never spam.

steps.title: CONNECT IMAP/SMTP INTO CRM
steps.detail: Add your mailbox directly inside CRM as an Email Channel so incoming messages sync automatically and replies send from your domain.

steps.title: ROUTE TEAM ADDRESSES INTO SHARED INBOXES
steps.detail: Pipe support@, sales@, and founders@ into shared team queues with custom labels, owner assignment, and full customer contact history.

sections.heading: 03 / WHY STARTUPS LOVE IT
